_: Fire, v2 (judged beside docs/art/target/04-siege.jpg: tall shaped flames off the roofs, a dark smoke column leaning in the wind, the house left a charred shell). fire.gd reads it. on: the switch (or --fire=v2; --fire=v1 forces the old puffs). Flames: GDQuest's stylized fire shader (MIT) on Kenney's flame tongues (CC0), in three toon bands. A burning house: flames on its roof and at its front, embers, smoke, a scorch, and it chars (roof falling in) as it burns. Which houses stay burnt is the bridge's damage fact (cities[].damage.burnt, bridge/damage.js), never a timer; share_sack/share_razed only pick how many burn when a sack plays before the damage is known. Sizes are in game units (a house is about 0.3 tall). walls: tongues from each burning house's upper walls (fire.gd _alight). v3 (docs/research/world-and-siege-rules.md, fire rules 1-6): spread: the raiders torch a few at once (spread.torched, never two within torch_apart of each other), the houses nearest where the camera looks (a sack must be seen); then houses catch one at a time, 3-12 s apart, the next the one most exposed to those already burning (nearer, downwind, thatch before timber before stone; Stronghold's travelling fire, Manor Lords' house to house); the bridge's fact still decides which houses burn, the spread only decides the order. stages: catching (smoke first, small flames), burning, collapse (the roof falls in with a burst of sparks), smouldering (a thin grey wisp, glowing char), then out (Age of Empires' stepped fire). columns: at most this many full smoke columns a town, the rest thin (Total War's far read). folk: the townsfolk near a catching house run from it; up to folk.line of the rest stand in a line from the well and pass pails until the roof falls in (Manor Lords), and while a line works the next house catches folk.slow times later. Batch 9 (soft flames): the flames as a flipbook of Kenney's tongues, a soft body and an additive core (soft); the light flickers; the char's glow in fine cracks (char.ember), not broad sheets; a house that burnt stays a ruin until the realm's burnt share drops (it rebuilds); a sack spreads to spread.least houses at least; lod thins far fires.

soft._: The soft flames (flames.look soft; else stylized, GDQuest's toon bands): Kenney's six flame tongues as a flipbook, each flame playing through them as it rises; body: its colour over its life, rows of [r, g, b, a], HDR (above 1 glows); core: the hot inner flames added on, core_size of the body's size, core_share as many; soft_edge: how softly they fade where they meet a wall or roof (world units).

lod._: Fewer flames and embers on far fires so many houses can burn at once: full out to near (world units from the camera), down to far_share of them by far; the smoke stays whole.
